list.name: asset_class
list.label: Asset class
list.query: Stocks : stock, BDRs : bdr, ETFs / funds / units : fund_unit, Futures : future, Equity derivatives : equity_derivative, Odd lot : odd_lot, Rights / receipts : right_receipt, Government / foreign : gov_foreign, Other : other

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    ticker,
    max(liquidity_limit) AS liquidity_limit,
    CASE
      WHEN ticker LIKE '% %' OR ticker LIKE 'NTN-%' OR regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z]{1,5}$') THEN 'gov_foreign'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}F$') THEN 'odd_lot'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}$')
        AND try_cast(substr(ticker, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN year(trad_dt) % 100 AND year(trad_dt) % 100 + 30
        AND (substr(ticker, 5, 2) NOT IN ('32', '33', '34', '35', '39') OR substr(ticker, 1, 3) IN ('DI1', 'DDI', 'OC1', 'DCO', 'DAP')) THEN 'future'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[3-8]$') THEN 'stock'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}3[1-59]$') THEN 'bdr'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}11$') OR ticker LIKE '%ETF11' THEN 'fund_unit'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}(9|1[02-9])$') THEN 'right_receipt'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]{2,3}(W[1-5])?$') OR regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}$') THEN 'equity_derivative'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS asset_class
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE NOT is_unlimited
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT ticker
FROM d
WHERE asset_class IN ($asset_class)
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY max(liquidity_limit) DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Selected tickers (range summary)
panels.description: First, latest, min and max limit, change and revisions per selected ticker over the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    ticker,
    max(liquidity_limit) AS liquidity_limit,
    CASE
      WHEN ticker LIKE '% %' OR ticker LIKE 'NTN-%' OR regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z]{1,5}$') THEN 'gov_foreign'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}F$') THEN 'odd_lot'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}$')
        AND try_cast(substr(ticker, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN year(trad_dt) % 100 AND year(trad_dt) % 100 + 30
        AND (substr(ticker, 5, 2) NOT IN ('32', '33', '34', '35', '39') OR substr(ticker, 1, 3) IN ('DI1', 'DDI', 'OC1', 'DCO', 'DAP')) THEN 'future'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[3-8]$') THEN 'stock'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}3[1-59]$') THEN 'bdr'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}11$') OR ticker LIKE '%ETF11' THEN 'fund_unit'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}(9|1[02-9])$') THEN 'right_receipt'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]{2,3}(W[1-5])?$') OR regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}$') THEN 'equity_derivative'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS asset_class
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE NOT is_unlimited
    AND ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    ticker,
    asset_class,
    lag(liquidity_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_limit,
    liquidity_limit
  FROM d
  WHERE asset_class IN ($asset_class)
),
ranged AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM changes
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
ids AS (
  SELECT ticker, string_agg(DISTINCT instrument_id::VARCHAR, ', ') AS instrument_ids
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND NOT is_unlimited
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT
  r.ticker,
  any_value(r.asset_class) AS asset_class,
  any_value(i.instrument_ids) AS instrument_ids,
  count(*) AS days,
  max(r.trad_dt) AS latest_dt,
  arg_min(r.liquidity_limit, r.trad_dt) AS first_limit,
  arg_max(r.liquidity_limit, r.trad_dt) AS latest_limit,
  min(r.liquidity_limit) AS min_limit,
  max(r.liquidity_limit) AS max_limit,
  (arg_max(r.liquidity_limit, r.trad_dt) / nullif(arg_min(r.liquidity_limit, r.trad_dt), 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS range_change,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.liquidity_limit <> r.prev_limit) AS revisions,
  max(r.trad_dt) FILTER (WHERE r.liquidity_limit <> r.prev_limit) AS last_revision
FROM ranged r
LEFT JOIN ids i ON i.ticker = r.ticker
GROUP BY r.ticker
ORDER BY latest_limit DESC

      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]{2,3}(W[1-5])?$') OR regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}$') THEN 'equity_derivative'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS asset_class
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE NOT is_unlimited
    AND ticker = $ticker
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    liquidity_limit,
    liquidity_limit / nullif(lag(liquidity_limit) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt), 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM d
  WHERE asset_class IN ($asset_class)
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, liquidity_limit AS "Limit", change AS "Change"
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time
